scope: Read-only current runtime and AWS authorization audit. Standard SDK noninteractive SSO renewal allowed by coordinating agent. No interactive login, credential/defaultconfig edits, queue mutations, fixture writes, transport sends, or service starts/restarts.

flow: Signed API JWT establishes real account tenant context
Encryption key/association resolves appliance serial and NOC instance GUID from local edge
OutboundEncryptionService fetches public account key by filer GUID with assumed NOC role
EdgeTransport encrypts envelope then calls NBN FIFO REST API using configured NBN authrole/SSM/APIkey
Task id travels as envelope metadata.trace_id; outbound message persisted after transport succeeds
Filer response -> NBN FIFO SNS topics -> personal account-filtered SQS FIFO queue
local_sqs_combined_poller invokes events_hub_stack.handler with SQS records
PortalEncryptionKeyProvider loads nbn/portal/dvista1/keys-active and keys-backup from SecretsManager
Handler resolves real account tenant and processes correlated task/step, persists messages/domain data, broadcasts through Redis/SSE
inbound.confirmed_exit_reason: Error: no queues configured. Set SQS_QUEUE_URL and/or SQS_NONFIFO_QUEUE_URL.

local_domain_baseline.meaning: Real tenant and real edge GUID/serial have not been registered in local DB

steps: aws sso login --sso-session portal-dev (interactive; NOT run)
aws configure export-credentials --profile portal-dev (credential output must be captured privately; NOT run)
Writes profile portal-dev static credentials and root .env.local AWS_PROFILE=portal-dev plus CodeArtifact URL (NOT run)

cached_client_behavior.source: backend/libs/portal-core/portal/core/aws/base.py AWSBase.client caches _client; boto3.client uses default session cached credentials; NbnApiKeyProvider caches key and client ID
cached_client_behavior.assessment: Updating shared credential file alone does not reliably switch an already initialized API worker to portal-dev. Existing default session has previously loaded invalid default credentials. A fresh API process configured explicitly with AWS_PROFILE=portal-dev is the reliable boundary; no worker restart or replacement performed.

next_coordinated_steps: Choose a fresh authorized test runtime explicitly using portal-dev without altering unrelated profiles
Establish an isolated personal response queue/subscription filtered to real test account; configure inbound secret names and start its local handler after root coordinates
Load real tenant/edge identity before dispatch; preserve existing filer resources and use dedicated test keys/volume
Verify inbound handler correlation before treating HTTP202 as completed operation
conclusion: Authorized portal-dev SSO session and required FIFO/NOC-role/inbound-secret reads are usable. Current default-profile webapi process and absent local response queue/poller are not yet ready for real-filer E2E.
